item.title: Byron Drive road surface deterioration, 9th August
item.description:
Location of Defect: Byron Drive, Northumberland Heath, Bexley (specifically the section of the carriageway running between house numbers 35 and 55). Description of Issue: I am writing to formally report a worsening and potentially hazardous road surface failure on Byron Drive. There are currently four distinct, bulges/heaves appearing in the carriageway, each directly surrounding a manhole cover. The two most severe defects have reached approximately 3 metres in width and rise to an estimated 12-15 inches deep/high relative to the sunken or compressed road base around them. This has caused the road surface to undulate in an unnatural, highly unstable manner, giving rise to the following concerns: 1. Impact and Safety Risks: Vehicle Damage: The severity of these vertical crests is causing standard passenger cars to bottom out and scrape their undercarriages on the asphalt. The increasingly undulating profile could force drivers to brake suddenly or swerve to avoid vehicle damage, presenting a potential risk to local traffic, cyclists, and pedestrians. 2. Structural Degradation: Given the proximity to the ironwork, this indicates a potential deep structural failure of the road sub-base, compaction failure, or severe utility/water main erosion underneath the pavement. Under the Highways Act 1980, the council has a duty to maintain the public highway in a safe condition. Because this failure is actively damaging vehicles and creating an uneven driving hazard, I request a site inspection by a highway engineer to assess the safety of this stretch and instruct immediate remedial repairs. I can see some green markings have been made around one of the vertical crests so it seems this is noticed already. I look forward to your response, inspection date or next steps Kind Regards, Phil Langley (resident of nearby Sussex Road)
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Byron Drive, Northumberland Heath, Greater London
